reviews.title: Special offer not honored
reviews.text: I play this game every day but I’m giving it three stars, which I will gladly change to five stars if the special offer gets honored. The downside is the ads so I took advantage of the “special offer” and paid to have NO ads. I’m still getting ads. I’ve tried three times and each time I get “you’ve already paid for this do you want to have this for free?” I hit yes and the ads keep coming, and not short ads, the most annoying looong ads that run for more than a minute.

reviews.title: Bad customer support
reviews.text: Despite that the game itself is truly great, however the developers lack the experience on how to handle their customers/players. The game asks you to download an update which NEVER is available. That simply means that the people behind this game simply don’t care nor do they follow up the game requirements. Which is truly a shame. If you don’t have the time to upload the updates, then simply remove the game from the store.

reviews.title: Great Game!
reviews.text:
Today I was just playing Subway surfers, and I realized that it wasn’t such a fun game. So I decided to go to the App Store, AMD look for new games to try. All of the sudden I saw that I had already downloaded Princess Run before. And I didn’t remember downloading it, so I played Princess Run. And I thought to myself, this is what better than Subway Surfers!! So later that day I decided to keep Princess Run, and delete Subway Surfers.

I am not saying Subway Surfers is bad and all, I just think that Princess Run in my opinion is better.

I have played it in a while now, and I can’t stop! It’s a cute running game, with good graphics and cool style! I absolutely love the background music you hear while playing. I also love the cool sound effects, and the great and cute characters.

Great work, and would love to have more updates of the game, and see more games from you guys (that also are available for  most platforms like IOS too, since Jungle Run 2 is only available for android) in the future. 

Thank you and keep it up with the great work!
